About

Designer who asks why before how.

I'm a product designer, researcher, and occasional product manager from Indonesia. What started as curiosity to create and build things evolved into a profession I'm genuinely passionate about — which honestly feels like cheating.

I'm proud to have worked with companies across various fields, designing digital products that many people use daily — from buying groceries to taking a flight.

My passion for UX started during my Computer Science degree at UI, when I realized I was more interested in the human side of technology than the technical side. Best pivot I ever made.

Off the clock: pool tables, concerts, and eating things I probably shouldn't have ordered in cities I've never been to before.

Photography

Through the lens

My camera is basically my fifth limb at this point. I shoot everything — editorial, portraits, products, street, nature, architecture. But if you catch me on a weekend, I'm probably chasing the perfect moment with a person in it. There's something about the fraction of a second before someone notices the camera that I genuinely can't stop thinking about. Also: sometimes the best shot is the one you almost didn't take because you left the camera at home and had to use your phone like a normal person.
